correctness.rationale: For a nonzero stripe, row blur equals \(Wt_j\), every blurred column occupancy equals \(3M\), and their normalized product cancels to \(q=t_j/m\); this directly proves invariance of stripes and width independence. Inspecting all local triple-count cases and interval endpoints gives Rule54 when m=3 (neighborhoods 101,100,010,001), Rule18 when m=2 (100,001), and zero for m<=1. If two adjacent ones arise under Rule18 then the third next site has a live old centre and is forced zero, so Rule18 cannot make 111; thus the phase boundary is one-way. Independently compared the piecewise update for every binary cyclic word of lengths 3 through 10 (2040 states) and followed the specified 13-letter seed through 169 distinct stages until return, each with m=3. This finite orbit is exactly the stated example, while the all-heights phase theorem follows the algebraic/local proof.
